projects.description: Below there are some projects I've worked on during my studies and my free time, as well as demos of commercial projects I've participated in and have received permission to publicate

project_1.title: Filmer
project_1.content: Bot to maintain a database of movies and videogames that are to be watched/played or that have been watched/played already. Moreover, the bot can also randomly decide a movie or game (among the ones saved in the DB).
project_1.keywords: Keywords: Discord, Python, SQLite DB, Symmetric Key Encryption

project_2.title: Client Support Bot
project_2.content: Customer support service for companies and firms that work with injectors and similar technical equipment. The bot is able to send information (upon request) about the firm itself, about injectors and about their availability. It can also save a user's chat ID in order to notify them about an injector's availability later on, in case the injector they looked for was not available when requested.
project_2.keywords: Keywords: Telegram, Python, SQLite DB, Machine Learning, Jupyter Notebook, Sequential Model

project_3.title: Unscammed
project_3.content: Software where user input is checked against three different algorithms on whether it is a spam/scam or ham message. Different datasets were used in order to train a Naive-Bayes, a Logistic Regression and a SVM algorithm, which are then imported to the back-end of the application and worked with.
project_3.keywords: Keywords: Python, PyQT5, Machine Learning, Jupyter Notebook, Naive-Bayes Model, Logistic Regression Model, Support Vector Machine Model

project_4.title: DWH 'Par'
project_4.content: Simulation of the creation of an online shop's Data WareHouse, with its ETL process and BI visualization. Provided below are the Logical ER Model, the DAG's Pipeline and the Dashboard Mockup.
project_4.keywords: Keywords: DWH, BI, PostgreSQL, Inmon's methodology, ETL, Apache Airflow, PIX BI

project_5.title: Common Rail Piezo Injector Tester
project_5.content: Software for registering tests of piezoelectric injectors by BOSCH, Denso, VDO/Siemens-Continental (with their reference values, test reports and graphs) of different clients. Aside from saving test results, injectors and client information in the database, the software also allows to export a PDF with the necessary data.
project_5.keywords: Keywords: C#, Winforms, SQLite DB, Generic Repository Pattern

project_6.title: Denso QR Coder
project_6.content: Database of Denso injectors, which allows to CODE inserted test values into the injector code or DECODE the inputted code into test values.

project_7.title: Bosch IMA Data
project_7.content: Database of BOSCH injectors (alphanumeric IMA 6-7-9 and ISA 7), which allows to CODE inserted test values (including ISA letter for ISA 7) into the injector code.

project_8.title: Pet Finder
project_8.content: Android application possibly useful for animal shelters and volunteers. The purpose is to save a route/walk done by the user and add information about stray animals seen during it. The app can be useful to monitor the life of stray animals in the area.
project_8.keywords: Keywords: Kotlin, Room, Model-View-ViewModel pattern, Google Maps API

project_9.title: Pepe Card Game
project_9.content: Browser Memory Card Game that includes a single-player mode (with easy, medium and hard difficulties) as well as a local multi-player mode that goes up to 4 players.
